primeira_execucao.p1.intro: Everything is optional, and you can change it later under Searches. The more you say, the better joBot ranks the jobs.
primeira_execucao.p1.cargos_dica: One per line, or separated by commas. Up to 20. To find more jobs, add variations of the same title (e.g. infrastructure, servers, sysadmin).
primeira_execucao.erro.salario: Invalid minimum salary: use numbers only, for example 5000 or 5000.50.
primeira_execucao.erro.moeda: I cannot convert that currency: pick one from the list.
primeira_execucao.erro.uf: Invalid state: use a Brazilian state code, like SP.
primeira_execucao.resumo.vazio: You skipped this part: jobs show up by date, with no fit score. You can say what you are looking for later, under Searches.
primeira_execucao.sites.texto: If you want, turn on the sites where you have an account. You can do this later in Settings.
primeira_execucao.sites.sem_navegador: Without a browser, the Sign in now button is turned off: download the browser above or install Google Chrome.
primeira_execucao.p2.explicacao: When on, joBot starts by itself when you log in and looks for jobs every 3 hours, even with the panel closed. When off, it only searches while it is open. You can change this later in settings.
primeira_execucao.p2.container: joBot will run in the container {container} (distrobox).
primeira_execucao.p2.nao_suportado: Background mode does not exist on this system yet: it comes in a future version. On this computer it stays off: joBot searches while it is open.
primeira_execucao.p2.recusa: Background mode could not be turned on
primeira_execucao.p2.erro_arquivos: I could not write the service files. It may be a permission or disk space problem (details in the log). You can try again or choose "Not now".
primeira_execucao.p2.aviso: Background mode could not be turned off properly: {motivo}. Try again in Settings > Background.
primeira_execucao.p2.aviso.arquivos: I could not change the service files (may be permission or disk; details in the log)
primeira_execucao.p2.aviso.systemctl_fal: systemctl could not turn the service off (details in the log)
primeira_execucao.p2.aviso.schtasks_falh: Task Scheduler could not delete the joBot task (details in the log)
primeira_execucao.p2.aviso.launchctl_fal: launchd could not remove the joBot service (details in the log)
primeira_execucao.pronto.texto: joBot can look for jobs now. Use the Search now button at the top, or see what is already here.
segundo_plano.sem_host_exec: could not reach the host system: distrobox-host-exec or distrobox-enter is missing
segundo_plano.systemd_nao_responde: the user systemd is not responding
segundo_plano.home_diferente: the container home folder is not the host home folder
segundo_plano.systemctl_falhou: systemctl {comando} failed. The details are in jobot.log.
segundo_plano.schtasks_falhou: schtasks {comando} failed. The details are in jobot.log.
segundo_plano.launchctl_falhou: launchctl {comando} failed. The details are in jobot.log.
primeira_execucao.ia.titulo: Do you want to use AI?
primeira_execucao.ia.intro: The AI reads the jobs and lists what each one asks for, to compare with your profile; it also helps fill in your profile and prepare applications. It is optional: choose now or later, in Settings › AI.
primeira_execucao.ia.local: Local model (free, runs on your PC)
primeira_execucao.ia.local.ajuda: It costs nothing: job texts and your profile stay on your computer. It is slower than a paid service.
primeira_execucao.ia.local.falta: The model has not been downloaded yet. After this setup, download it in Settings › Tools › Local AI model and turn it on in Settings › AI, under All offline.
primeira_execucao.ia.pago.ajuda: Uses the Anthropic API (Claude) with your key. OpenAI, Google Gemini and compatible services are in Settings › AI.
primeira_execucao.ia.pago.custo: Cost: charged per use, on your Anthropic account. With matching on, joBot makes up to {teto} requests a day, one per new job that matches a search; the other tasks only ask when you click. Experimental, not yet proven.
primeira_execucao.ia.pago.privacidade: Job texts go to Anthropic. Your résumé text, without email, phone and CPF, goes when you ask to read it. Your profile, without your name and contact details, only goes when you ask.
primeira_execucao.ia.chave.ajuda: It stays in the system password vault and never comes back to the screen.
primeira_execucao.ia.chave.guardada: A key is already saved: leave this blank to keep it.
primeira_execucao.ia.nenhum.ajuda: Skips this step and turns the AI off. A setup you built in Settings › AI stays as it is. While the AI is off, nothing leaves your computer.
primeira_execucao.ia.erro.sem_modelo: The local model has not been downloaded yet: choose another option.
primeira_execucao.ia.erro.chave_sem_pago: You typed a key: choose Paid service or clear the key.
primeira_execucao.perfil.intro: Answer what you like, everything is optional: your profile helps compare jobs with you and prepare applications. You can add work experience and courses later, in Settings › Profile.
primeira_execucao.perfil.curriculo_salvo: Résumé saved to your profile: check the answers below.
